# Reliability ladder

## Associate {#associate}

Follows a runbook, escalates early, and writes down what they saw.

## Engineer {#engineer}

Diagnoses an unfamiliar incident on their own, and communicates while they do.

## Senior {#senior}

Finds the systemic cause, and fixes the class of failure.

## Staff {#staff}

Changes how several teams operate, and weighs reliability against cost and delivery.
